title: cyclosorus pendens
intro: Cyclosorus pendens, commonly known as the Hanging Lip Fern, is a species of fern native to tropical regions of Asia and Australia. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, such as fever, respiratory issues, and inflammatory diseases, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and acting as an expectorant. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its antipyretic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Cyclosorus pendens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
